span.p:
On every request:
1. Read session from Redis
2. Validate auth
3. Route request
4. Extend TTL

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Scale:
- 450M MAU, ~50M active sessions
- ~100K session reads/sec
- 12-node Redis Cluster (6 primaries, 6 replicas)
- P99 latency: under 5ms
- Session TTL: 24 hours (sliding window, extends on each access)
